review.summary: The current evidence does not qualify as real model validation due to insufficient proof status and missing critical data fields. The 24-month quote rows are offers rather than settled outcomes, and there is no verified dealer identity or timestamped observation paths linked to note IDs.
top_technical_reasons: Insufficient proof status for model validation.
24-month quote rows are offers, not settled note outcomes.
Dealer identity is not verified as BCS Capital.
No timestamped observation paths linked to note IDs.
review.candidate_safety: High risk due to lack of verified data and insufficient evidence for model validation.

next_experiments.metric_gate: Verification of dealer identities for at least 80% of quote records.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will help establish the credibility of the data and ensure that the model is based on reliable sources.
